evidence_basis: Four user-supplied research memos in resume_information, dated 2026-09-11. Their cited external pages have not been independently reverified for this implementation.

achievement.memo: Research Memo_ Human-Readable Achievement Writing for Recruiter-Facing Resumes.md
achievement.scope: Institutional practice guidance; largely student and early-career sources; no universal hiring-outcome proof.

structure.memo: ATS Parsing and Document Structure_ Evidence-Led Resume Authoring Memo.md
structure.scope: Named vendor parsing risks and accessibility guidance; no universal ATS guarantee.

market.memo: Research Memo_ UK and US Resume_CV Conventions for Job Applications.md
market.scope: UK and US conventions; current specialized portal requirements require verification before enforcement.

screening.memo: Research memo_ AI-assisted recruitment screening, fairness, and resume authorship.md
screening.scope: Screening variability and simulation limits; no candidate ranking or hiring prediction.

rules.rule: Preserve contribution, ownership, metric basis, dates, constraints and publication permissions. New claims return to Core review.
Record employer instructions, user choices and inferred defaults separately. Specialized portal limits are not hardcoded without current verification.
Deliver PDF, UTF-8 TXT and editable DOCX from identical shared content, with separate verification and failure reporting.
Use one text column, conventional headings, semantic paragraphs and lists, and transparent reverse chronology.
Omit photos, sensitive demographic details, full street addresses, referee contacts and immigration identifiers. Apply explicit anonymisation instructions.
Allocate space by distinct contribution. Do not impose age-based role deletion, a fixed bullet count, a mandatory summary or a metric quota.
Use precise natural wording the person can explain in an interview. Preserve sourced context and calibrate attribution.
Separate integrity, representation, relevance, readability and export checks. Label reviewer assumptions; do not predict hiring success or penalize gaps and lateral moves by default.

Record exact-draft constraint and prominence checks, private strength comparisons, measured compression when shortening is requested, and categorized findings with derived revision usage. Generate handoffs from validated records; editorial budget exhaustion never waives integrity failures.
